goal: Finish the leader this turn; defense is unnecessary if the attack sequence completes.
guidance: Priest has 39 HP. Setup Strike first deals 15 and adds four temporary Strength. The upgraded Strike then deals 21 through Vulnerable and the other Strike deals 16: enough to finish this turn. Direct these attacks at Priest, not followers. Do not spend energy on Defend while this kill is available. Headbutt can also contribute but creates an unnecessary selection; prefer the ordinary attacks. The program takes over when any supported single Strike becomes a verified lethal.
